reason: Both stem from the same root fact (abydos IIS site NimbusStaging binds by explicit host header with no catch-all, so an unmatched Host yields an http.sys 404 before app routing), but they give different actionable knowledge for different scenarios: ab3bc2f7 is a local-diagnostic gotcha (pass an explicit Host header when probing localhost, so a 404 isn't misread as a failed deploy), while f2d4ea02 is a deploy/cutover step (add a New-WebBinding for a newly proxied hostname like cutover-test/nimbusdigitalart.com, and adds the us-ascii vs utf-8 http.sys-404 diagnostic signature). Complementary, not restating each other; neither supersedes the other.
